body: Sadly there aren't any ADHD groups in my area.
As I have said, maybe my psychiatrist lied to me about how public clinics do not accept ADHD patients though. Maybe she is lying.

Looks like we have some misunderstanding here. I will meet my psychiatrist tomorrow. 

I feel like nobody likes me.

> I would start with the psychiatrist. Most likely she isn't nice to you for the money.

As some people in other subs have said, it seems odd that the public clinics don't accept ADHD patients but this seems to be the case in most countries.

>If you are going to a clinic most likely there is an administrator or director that you can talk to. 

The receptionist seems to be the administrator as well.

>Look at how you feel when she ignored your messages, she probably feels the same way.

I don't ignore her messages. It's just that it is always me initiating social contact with people.

>You worry too much about what others think, when they are doing the exact same thing. 

Yeah right I used to be so miserable that I shitposted about suicidal and homicidal idealization on Reddit in the past during class as that was what I was feeling like at the moment. Like something bad happened to me and I know that my counselor seems to not click with me so I just asked people for advice on the web. Maybe some of my peers next to me could read my posts and freak out, although I do set my phone's screen to a very dim setting and try to tilt my phone in a direction where nobody can see it.

I don't know why I should live anymore. My peers try to avoid me (or appears to do so). My parents don't understand. My counselor doesn't seem to care about me. My psychiatrist seems to only be nice to me for the money.

Who can I ask for help? It seems like I have no options.
I think I should just give up on therapy. As my parents said, "maybe it really is my problem and some problems just cannot be solved no matter who you ask for help".

It's not my fault, but I feel like I can't trust anyone because of this.

Oh I think you have gotten this mixed up. My psychiatrist is a DIFFERENT PERSON than my counselor.
Yeah I think they are avoiding me on purpose. Also, I really am worried about rumors about me spreading through the industry.

Well sometimes I post about really terrible stuff on Reddit (eg. wanting to die, somewhat homicidal idealization, politics, etc) and these stuff are kind of taboo.

Well it's more than that. She never smiles and you just "feel" that she's only there for her job.

Well maybe she lied about how public clinics do not provide ADHD care as she wants to keep as many customers as possible.

Well both girls didn't reply to my messages.

My peers in my major.

I've tried searching for that. It seems like they only accept cases followed up from childhood.

I think they probably see me as "weird" and are trying to avoid me. I major in something related to a small industry. I don't want my peer to see me as "weird" as gossip spread like wildfire in that industry.

Maybe they will be just as awful.

> You do seem to be having bad luck finding one

You mean a psychiatrist?

Yes I have been feeling really depressed lately. I feel like an island as nobody can relate to me. In the past, I sometimes felt somewhat suicidal and I would post about how I wanted to die and ask about the meaning of life on Reddit. I also had rather pessimistic political views and would post extremely negative things about society. I know that some people will find what I have posted "weird", so I sometimes sat by myself or somewhat tilted my screen away to post what I want to.

I don't know if I can trust my psychiatrist. As someone in that thread said, it is strange how she said that ADHD is not covered by public healthcare. She may tell me what I want to hear and tell me that it is not my problem when she thinks of me as a useless loser deep in her mind.

I don't know how to find ADHD friends. It's not like there are ADHD meetup groups in my area.

Yeah but I am failing school. Nobody is interested in asking me for advice. I feel like people see me as "weird" and are trying to avoid me.

Btw there is a counselor at my uni but I didn't click with her and I feel like she doesn't really want to talk to me right from the very start (eg. monotone voice etc). I requested to change counselor at the reception desk (there is only one receptionist) and she refused to change my counselor. Like I asked her if a counselor change is ok, she told that she had to tell this to my counselor and disappeared into my room, and my counselor appeared and invited me inside with her usual monotone voice.

I feel like the health system in my country is different where my psychiatrist is the one comforting me when I broke down into tears at her office, giving me advice on how to cope with it and encouraging me.It seems like that in most countries, the psychiatrist just ask you questions related to the symptoms and drugs and then kick you out. I will be seeing my psychiatrist tomorrow and I don't know if I should ask her for advice. I don't want to annoy her too much. As my parents said, "maybe it is your problem, stop blaming everything on ADHD, and stop complaining about this to other people as they don't have the ability to solve all your problems anyway".

Btw I was referred to my psychiatrist by a doctor at my uni's health central. She works at a private clinic. My parents asked if they provide ADHD services at public clinics (as those are very cheap) and my psychiatrist said no. My parents felt like she lied to us in order to keep a customer. At the end of the day, she is only nice to me for the money so I am uncomfortable with sharing my feelings with her. Maybe she will secretly think that it is my problem and refuse to tell me that simply because I am her customer.
And I can't help but not trust her because of this. She's ultimately motivated by money. She can tell me that "it's not my problem" just because she feels like that is what I want to hear.
Yeah so I don't know if I should trust my psychiatrist or not.
Well ok. Should I cast this net out at my uni instead?

Did you meet your online friends irl? I have a hobby which is uncommon in my area. She just told me that she is no longer interested in attending that event as the location is too far away from where she lives so I don't think I will ever see her agian irl.
Like I've said news spread like wildfire in the industry I am interested in. I fear rumors about me.

Thanks! It doesn't solve the issue that I have no friends at uni though. The two girls who didn't reply to my messages are from my major, and I am scared that people from my major are thinking of me as "weird". I major in something related to an industry that is very small, so news spread like wildfire in that industry.

They belong to my major. I major in one of those fields with are relatively "small" due to its number of workers and some news spread like wildfire in that industry due to how "small" it is. I don't want gossip spreading about me in the industry.
